title: Values of the second-level leaves
statement: Let $n,k$ be natural numbers with $k\le n$, let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$ and $x\in\{0,1\}^n$, and take $r<2^k$. The value at vertex $n+o_Z(n,k)+(2^k+r-1)$ is true exactly when the heap path of $x$ from offset $n-k$ at depth $k$ equals $2^k+r$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $n$-bit inputs
